prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1093; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured states the other vehicle merged into their lane without signaling. Both drivers reported no visible injuries at the scene. Photos requested from insured and damage appraisal ordered for both vehicles.

Entry 2: Recorded statements taken from insured and the other driver. Other driver disputes the lane change account and states the insured drifted over. Independent witness not identified at this time. Liability remains disputed; preliminary assessment leans toward shared fault pending scene evidence review.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Letter of representation received and claimant's file opened under attorney direction. All further contact with the claimant to be routed through counsel. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness following the collision and has been referred for medical evaluation. Records request sent to treating provider.

Entry 4: Medical records received showing diagnosis of whiplash-associated neck strain with a recommended course of physical therapy. Counsel submitted a demand package with supporting bills and wage documentation. Demand under review. Requested itemized billing and prior treatment history to verify causation and reasonableness of charges.

Entry 5: Liability position updated after reviewing the vehicle damage pattern and dashcam footage from the insured's vehicle. Footage supports the insured's account of the other vehicle moving into the lane. File referred to supervisor for settlement authority review on the bodily injury claim, and response to counsel's demand scheduled for the next review cycle.
